question: A half-wave rectifier is driven by a $50 \text{ Hz}$ AC source. A capacitor filter is connected in parallel with a load resistor of $1 \text{ k}\Omega$ to smooth the output. To achieve effective filtering, the time constant of the discharge circuit must be at least 10 times the time period of the input AC signal. What is the minimum required capacitance of the filter capacitor?
